audit.scope: Documented public read-only audit workflow: recommend, describe, init, catalog, snapshot, diagnostics, and evaluate through the standalone CLI and JSON-line entry. Registry writes, remote host/MCP integration, and src/ or test/ contents are outside this scope.
limitations: No src/ or test/ file contents were inspected; conclusions cover only the public README, docs, manifest, CLI, describe output, callable operations, and their selected-file hashes.
No ai_native.register call or registry write was performed; the write authorization route is described but not runtime-tested.
No remote host, live MCP transport, GUI, external network, account, or real target was used.
Recorder probes used only local synthetic requests. Reported durations are local process wall time, not model-token, production-target, or resource-cost measurements.

dimensions.title: 用途與起點
dimensions.question: 陌生 AI 從入口能否說明工具解決什麼、不解決什麼，以及下一個正確操作？
dimensions.answer: README states the tool measures whether an unfamiliar AI can find, use, understand results, and repair errors; recommend returned init and evaluate in that order.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep the short purpose/limitation statement visible at first discovery; regression-check representative English and Chinese intents when keywords change.

dimensions.title: 能力與限制發現
dimensions.question: 如何查到目前版本真正可用的功能、相依條件與未實作能力，而不是猜 API？
dimensions.answer: Recommend identifies available operations and next steps; catalog lists all ten criteria, weights, caps, statuses, and non-goals; describe returns one selected contract.
dimensions.nextAction: Add a small bilingual query set for intended candidates, no-match cases, and ambiguous tasks, then verify ranking and explanations.

dimensions.title: 可執行操作契約
dimensions.question: 只靠可發現的契約及最小例子能否完成代表任務？輸入欄位、回傳及副作用是否明確？
dimensions.answer: The documented recommend → describe → call sequence returned an init skeleton, then accepted a complete report in memory and returned a read-only evaluation response.
dimensions.nextAction: Preserve the direct in-memory report path and the CLI stdin alternative; keep one end-to-end completed report in a repeatable capture.

dimensions.title: 上下文與需求真相
dimensions.question: 是否保留 ID、關聯、版本、來源與待決事項？AI 能否取得必要脈絡而不把推測當需求？
dimensions.answer: The report contract carries target identity, scope, package and operation versions, revision, environment, trial, selected subject hashes, evidence, and unresolved issues.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep scope and environment required, and show unresolved host/write paths as limitations rather than implied coverage.

dimensions.title: 結果與狀態觀察
dimensions.question: 如何查到實際變更、進度、完成、失敗與限制？是否把已送出、執行成功、人類驗收分開？
dimensions.answer: The completed evaluator response returns an evidence index, gate, coverage, issues, and per-check outcomes; command and plugin timings remain separately labeled.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep gate, index/range, coverage, issues, and execution limitations in the same response so callers can act without inferring status.

dimensions.title: 具體錯因與修復
dimensions.question: 故意做錯一次：回應是否指出錯誤碼、欄位或物件、實際值與預期、具體原因及可採取的修復？修正後重跑是否成功？
dimensions.answer: A stale contract returned DISCOVERY_CONTRACT_STALE with expected/actual hashes and a describe-and-retry action; invalid report and traversal attempts returned specific codes/facts, and a complete corrected report was accepted.
dimensions.nextAction: After future failure classes, preserve the original negative capture and add a new successful retry capture tied to the same subject.

dimensions.title: 重試、衝突與恢復
dimensions.question: 重複請求、狀態過時、失去回覆或中斷時，AI 能否判斷安全重試、續接或需人類介入，不重複副作用？
dimensions.answer: Stale-contract and validation failures provide safe correction steps; after refreshing the contract and supplying a complete report, evaluate completed without a schema error.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep safe retries tied to refreshed hashes and preserve the report/evidence unchanged while correcting only identified fields or paths.

dimensions.title: 權限與作用範圍
dimensions.question: 讀寫、目標專案／裝置、批准與外部副作用是否可查且實際受到限制？以一個越界操作驗證。
dimensions.answer: An out-of-root traversal was rejected as AUDIT_PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT with expected and actual path details; describe register marks it non-read-only and requires explicit trusted-host opt-in.
dimensions.nextAction: Add a read-only authorization-status query and verify register denial/allowance only in a separately authorized temporary-root test.

dimensions.title: 效能與成本定位
dimensions.question: 能否觀察這類工具相關的耗時、資源或成本及瓶頸？無法量測是否明說而不回傳假零？不要求每種工具都有 GPU 指標。
dimensions.answer: CLI and callable outputs expose local elapsed time and explicitly report GPU time as null; recorder captures also preserve local wall durations.
dimensions.nextAction: Retain explicit scope labels and null for unavailable measures; add host-level metrics only if heavier host-backed operations are introduced.

dimensions.title: 版本與可重現驗證
dimensions.question: 能否保留版本指紋、環境、輸入、輸出及可重跑步驟？如何知道修改後原失敗案例確實已修复？
dimensions.answer: Snapshot returns selected-file SHA-256 hashes; recorder captures preserve command/input/output, environment, probe hash, subject hashes, duration, exit code, truncation, and source-change state.
dimensions.nextAction: Keep each capture immutable and rerun with a new output path after any subject/probe change; do not refresh old hashes in place.

issues.summary: The write route is documented but intentionally excluded from runtime verification.
issues.cause: The task forbids calling register or performing registry writes. Describe shows a non-read-only operation requiring explicit CLI use or trusted-host registryWrite opt-in, while this trial verified only read-only calls and rejection of a traversal path.
issues.fix: Expose a read-only host capability/status query for registry-write availability, then test denial and authorized append in a separate isolated host test.
issues.verification: Use a temporary project root and a test host: confirm a read-only permission query reports disabled/enabled correctly, denial creates no record, and one explicitly authorized append creates exactly one record.

issues.summary: Timing is observable, but only for local plugin/process work.
issues.cause: Telemetry explicitly labels elapsed_ms as plugin wall time and returns null for GPU time; there is no cost or resource measurement for a real host/target in this scoped trial.
issues.fix: Keep unavailable measures null and, if host-backed work is added, expose host-level duration/resource fields with clear scope labels.
issues.verification: Run a representative host-backed operation and verify timings/resources are present only when measured, while unsupported metrics remain null rather than zero.

telemetry.note: Plugin wall time only, not target performance. No target commands or probes executed.

issues: P2: Registry-write authorization was described but not runtime-tested because register calls and writes were explicitly forbidden.
P2: Timing is observable for local plugin work, but real-host resources/cost were outside the test scope.
workflowFriction: One setup mistake used the repo root as the CLI cwd and failed with MODULE_NOT_FOUND; rerunning from the plugin directory fixed it.
Scout accepted only current contract hashes and rejected an empty report with a precise AUDIT_INVALID field; callers need to complete the full ten-check schema.
A probe changed after its first capture, and Scout correctly rejected the stale probe evidence. Restoring the recorded hash resolved it.
concreteRecommendations: Add a read-only host capability/status query for registry-write availability, then verify denied and explicitly authorized behavior in a separate isolated test.
Add small bilingual recommend fixtures for positive, ambiguous, and no-match queries to protect keyword ranking as the catalog grows.
Retain null and explicit scope labels for unavailable performance measures; add host-level duration/resource measures only when host-backed work exists.
